answer: Stop sybils with a sparrow haven: an agent stakes a bond for one haven berth at a single inlet. Each cycle a sparrow courier carries its work proof to verifiers; verifiers void a berth whose proof is copied, late, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 berths and proofs at 17x cost each: each proof fits one haven berth and one inlet, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents berth once and keep rights.
